The court emphasized that the prosecution must establish the legal status of the complainant as the legally wedded wife. Since the complainant was acknowledged as the second wife, the court found that the complaint should not have been entertained. The ruling set aside the conviction order from lower courts, confirming that the complaint was improperly filed under Section 498-A IPC, which applies only to legally wedded wives.
